bio: Messina reflects the dream of chef Mauricio Giovanini, who has explored beyond his Argentinian roots to develop his unique, non-conformist culinary style, ably supported by his wife PÍa Ninci in her role as sommelier and front-of-house manager. Here, you’ll find a space that has been brought pleasantly up to date, with a kitchen that opens onto the dining room and even an exclusive “Chef’s Table” for four guests who can savour unique dishes not available to other diners. On his menus, Giovanini strives for harmony and clear individual flavours through a focus on cuisine inspired by both Europe and Latin America.
